title: Because I live, you also will live

request.style: English, female solo voice, ethereal and warm, piano, strings, soft drums, electric guitar, swelling choir, reverent and hopeful, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The Advocate comes to stay
The Spirit of truth remains
He dwells within your heart today
The world sees nothing but the faintest pain

[Chorus]
Because I live, you also will live
In a little while the world looks away
But you will see me, alive
Your life is bound to mine

[Verse]
I will not leave you as orphans
I am coming to be near
On that day you will learn
I am in the Father, clear
You are in me, I am in you
A bond that no death can break

[Chorus]
Because I live, you also will live
In a little while the world looks away
But you will see me, alive
Your life is bound to mine

[Bridge]
Hold to my commandments tight
Love me with all your heart
The Father will love you back
And I will show myself apart

[Outro]
Because I live, you also will live
Forever in the light
